phase: Phase 20: Dynamic Mesh Directed Routing, AODV-Lite Route Optimization & RF Collision Reduction

stories.title: Pure KMP AODV-Lite Directed Routing Engine & Route Table Arbiter
stories.description: Implement pure KMP RoutingModels.kt, RoutingTable.kt, and AodvRoutingEngine.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/mesh/routing/. Implements on-demand route discovery via RouteRequest (RREQ), RouteReply (RREP), and RouteError (RERR) control frames, monotonic destination sequence numbering for loop-freedom, dynamic link quality cost metrics (ETX derived from RSSI and hop count), and route table expiry with zero Java, C, or platform-specific dependencies (Rules 2 & 3).
acceptanceCriteria: Pure KMP implementation with zero Java, C, or platform-specific dependencies in commonMain (Rules 2 & 3)
Generates, propagates, and processes RREQ, RREP, and RERR protocol messages
Maintains loop-free routing table with destination sequence numbers, next-hop pointers, and hop metrics
Falls back to controlled flooding when route to target destination is unknown or expired
100% unit test pass across JVM, Android, and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: Selective Unicast/Multicast Forwarding & RF Airtime Contention Mitigator
stories.description: Integrate AodvRoutingEngine and LinkMetricCalculator.kt into MeshTransport.kt / forwarding pipeline. Allows unicast packets (canned hazard text, trail file chunks, remote diagnostics) and channel-scoped multi-hop packets to selectively transmit via optimal next-hop nodes rather than blind broadcast flooding. Implements link break detection and triggers RERR broadcast to self-heal broken mesh paths.
acceptanceCriteria: Selectively directs packet transmission along discovered optimal paths when available
Tracks link delivery ratios and RSSI to dynamically update link cost metrics
Detects next-hop transmission failures and triggers automatic RERR route invalidation
Suppresses redundant packet re-broadcasts on intermediate nodes not on the path
100% unit test pass across JVM, Android, and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: Subsystem Hardware Bridge Wiring & Multiplatform Mesh Topology HUD Presentation
stories.description: Wire AodvRoutingEngine into IntercomHardwareBridge, AndroidPlatformBridge, and IntercomBridge (iosMain) with typed CancellationHandle observers. Expose reactive RoutingSnapshot (active routes, next hops, link ETX costs, RF airtime savings). Display routing indicators and vector path connections on ProximityRadarView.kt / HomeScreen.kt (Compose Multiplatform) and ContentView.swift / TacticalVectorRadarView (100% Native iOS SwiftUI) respecting Rule 1.
acceptanceCriteria: Hardware bridges expose routing snapshot flow and route control hooks
Exposes reactive CancellationHandle observers for routing state on iOS (Rule 1)
Compose Multiplatform displays mesh routing topology status badge and radar vector links
100% Native iOS SwiftUI displays tactical routing efficiency badge and multi-hop paths (Rule 1)
Full compilation and automated verification pass across all targets

stories.title: 24-Node Large-Scale Directed Mesh RF Contention Benchmark & Archify Showcase Update
stories.description: Implement DirectedMeshSimulationHarness.kt simulating a 24-node convoy across complex topologies (linear column, split groups, terrain obstruction). Measure packet collision rates, end-to-end latency, and route convergence times compared to naive flood relay. Update Archify interactive architecture specifications to showcase quality.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulates 24-node convoy under varying RF link quality, packet loss, and node mobility
Demonstrates >= 60% reduction in total forwarded packets for unicast and route-directed traffic
Verifies fast route self-healing (<300ms) upon simulated link break or node dropout
Archify architecture specification and HTML showcase updated with 9/9 verification pass
Full multiplatform test suite pass across all targets
